scope: New South Wales. The all-resident control from Table 9 reconciles with the Table 8 religion classes. The footnoted 4,287 Aboriginal people whose religions were not recorded are outside the ABS-compatible denominator.
Victoria. The Table 8 total is used. No separate comparable Aboriginal denomination counts are assigned.
Queensland. The Table 9 count plus the footnoted 20,000 people separately estimated with religion unrecorded is the Table 8 denominator. The footnoted addition is excluded from the opening shares.
South Australia including the Northern Territory. The 27,123 Aboriginal residents explicitly included without religion returns are excluded from the opening shares.
Western Australia. The Table 8 total is used. No separate comparable Aboriginal denomination counts are assigned.
Tasmania. The Table 8 total is used.
